series.name: IVEM Series 3kVA~5kVA hybrid inverter/charger
series.notes: 48 V hybrid inverter/charger, up to 12 units in parallel. NOTE the code-string collision with SERIES 2: here 51 = 'BMS does not allow inverter to CHARGE battery' and 52 = 'BMS does not allow inverter to DISCHARGE battery', which is the OPPOSITE assignment to the IVGM table. Always read the model. Codes 1-26, 30-39, 47-49, 55-79 and 81+ in the fault table have no extractable code number in the source PDF and are NOT transcribed - see NEGATIVE.

meaning.ur: BMS firmware update karna zaroori hai.

causes.en: Pack supplied with a BMS firmware older than the inverter expects
causes.ur: Pack aisa BMS firmware ke sath aaya hai jo inverter se purana hai

causes.en: Inverter updated but the BMS was left on the old protocol
causes.ur: Inverter update ho gaya lekin BMS purane protocol par chala gaya

solutions.en: Note the BMS version shown on the LCD BMS information page.
solutions.ur: LCD BMS information page par dikhne wala BMS version note karein.

solutions.en: Update the BMS firmware through the app while the pack is connected and awake.
solutions.ur: Pack connected aur awake hone par app se BMS firmware update karein.

solutions.en: Update every pack in a parallel bank; mixed BMS firmware versions prevent parallel operation.
solutions.ur: Parallel bank ke har pack ko update karein; alag BMS firmware versions parallel chalna rok dete hain.

source.title: IVEM Series (3KVA~5KVA) Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-010045-10)

aliases: BMS doesn't allow inverter to charge battery

title.ur: Warning 51 BMS charging rok raha hai

meaning.en: The BMS has blocked charging; the inverter stops charging the battery automatically.
meaning.ur: BMS ne charging block kar di hai; inverter khud-ba-khud battery charge karna band kar deta hai.

causes.en: Battery cell voltage at the BMS charge cut-off
causes.ur: Battery cell ka voltage BMS charge cut-off par pohanch gaya

causes.en: Battery temperature outside the BMS permitted range
causes.ur: Battery temperature BMS ke allowed range se bahar hai

causes.en: Cell imbalance or an internal BMS fault latched
causes.ur: Cell imbalance ya BMS ka koi internal fault latch ho gaya

solutions.en: Read the BMS page on the LCD and note the battery voltage and temperature reported.
solutions.ur: LCD ka BMS page padhein aur battery voltage aur temperature note karein.

solutions.en: Charge the pack from PV or grid so the BMS releases the inhibit, then confirm charging resumes.
solutions.ur: Pack ko PV ya grid se charge karein taake BMS inhibit chhor de, phir charging resume ka confirm karein.

solutions.en: Check the pack's own SOC LED and temperature sensor; a failed sensor makes the BMS block permanently.
solutions.ur: Pack ka apna SOC LED aur temperature sensor check karein; kharab sensor BMS ko hamesha block kar deta hai.

source.title: IVEM Series (3KVA~5KVA) Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-010045-10)

aliases: BMS doesn't allow inverter to discharge battery

title.ur: Warning 52 BMS discharge rok raha hai

meaning.en: The BMS has blocked discharging; the inverter stops discharging automatically.
meaning.ur: BMS ne discharge block kar diya hai; inverter khud-ba-khud discharging band kar deta hai.

causes.en: Battery SOC reached the BMS discharge floor
causes.ur: Battery SOC BMS discharge floor tak pohanch gaya

causes.en: Battery temperature too low or too high for discharge
causes.ur: Battery temperature discharge ke liye bohat kam ya bohat zyada hai

causes.en: Pack over-current protection latched after a surge
causes.ur: Surge ke baad pack ka over-current protection latch ho gaya

solutions.en: Confirm the SOC on the LCD; if it is at the floor the pack needs charging, not repair.
solutions.ur: LCD par SOC confirm karein; agar woh floor par hai to pack ko charging chahiye, marammat nahi.

solutions.en: Check the pack temperature sensor reading against a contact thermometer.
solutions.ur: Pack ke temperature sensor ki reading contact thermometer se verify karein.

solutions.en: Power-cycle the pack breaker once; if the BMS still blocks, read the BMS fault code on the LCD.
solutions.ur: Pack breaker ko aik baar power-cycle karein; BMS ab bhi block kare to LCD par BMS fault code padhein.

source.title: IVEM Series (3KVA~5KVA) Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-010045-10)

aliases: BMS require inverter to charge battery

title.ur: Warning 53 BMS charging maang raha hai

meaning.en: The BMS has asked the inverter to charge the battery; charging starts automatically.
meaning.ur: BMS ne inverter se battery charge karne ko kaha hai; charging khud-ba-khud shuru ho jati hai.

causes.en: Cell imbalance so the BMS wants a balancing top-up charge
causes.ur: Cell imbalance hai, is liye BMS balancing top-up charge chahta hai

causes.en: Battery stored long enough for a recovery charge
causes.ur: Battery itni der rahi ke recovery charge aa gaya

causes.en: SOC below the BMS recovery threshold
causes.ur: SOC BMS recovery threshold se neeche hai

solutions.en: Let the automatic charge finish; repeated interruption keeps the request active.
solutions.ur: Automatic charge poora hone dein; baar baar rokne se request qayamat rehti hai.

solutions.en: Check that the charge current for this pack is not set to 0 A in the LCD setup.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke LCD setup mein is pack ka charge current 0 A par set to nahi hai.

solutions.en: After charging, confirm cell voltages on the BMS page have come closer together.
solutions.ur: Charging ke baad confirm karein ke BMS page par cell voltages aik doosre ke qareeb aa gaye hain.

source.title: IVEM Series (3KVA~5KVA) Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-010045-10)

title.ur: Warning 54-65 BMS ne fault detect kiya

meaning.en: The BMS has detected some internal fault; the manual says contact the installer if the code persists.
meaning.ur: BMS ne koi internal fault detect kiya hai; manual ke mutabiq code zyada der tak rahe to installer se rabta karein.

causes.en: Cell over/under voltage inside the pack
causes.ur: Pack ke andar cell over ya under voltage

causes.en: Charge or discharge over-current inside the pack
causes.ur: Pack ke andar charge ya discharge over current

causes.en: Cell or pack temperature outside the permitted range
causes.ur: Cell ya pack temperature allowed range se bahar

solutions.en: Read the exact BMS fault code and flag from the LCD BMS information page and write it down.
solutions.ur: LCD BMS information page se exact BMS fault code aur flag padhein aur likh lein.

solutions.en: Let the BMS finish its balancing/recovery action and re-read the code after 30 minutes.
solutions.ur: BMS ko apna balancing/recovery action poora karne dein aur 30 minute baad code dobara padhein.

solutions.en: If the code persists, contact the installer as the manual directs; do not keep cycling the pack.
solutions.ur: Code zyada der tak rahe to manual ke mutabiq installer se rabta karein; pack ko baar baar on/off na karein.

notes.en: The manual prints this as a RANGE 54~65, not a single code. The app should treat any BMS code in 54-65 as this bucket; the specific meaning is only available from the BMS itself.
notes.ur: Manual mein yeh RANGE 54~65 ke tor par chhapa hai, aik code nahin. App ko 54-65 ka koi bhi BMS code isi bucket mein rakhna chahiye; asal matlab sirf BMS se pata chalega.

source.title: IVEM Series (3KVA~5KVA) Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-010045-10)

meaning.en: The inverter cannot talk to the BMS; check that the communication line is connected well.
meaning.ur: Inverter BMS se baat nahi kar pa raha; check karein ke communication line theek lagi hai.

causes.en: CAN communication cable loose at the inverter or the pack end
causes.ur: CAN communication cable inverter ya pack ke sifar par dhili hai

causes.en: Battery type not set to Lib, so the inverter never opens the BMS link
causes.ur: Battery type Lib par set nahi hai, is liye inverter BMS link kabhi nahi kholta

causes.en: Pack not powered, so its BMS cannot answer
causes.ur: Pack ki power nahi hai, is liye uska BMS jawab nahi de sakta

solutions.en: Reseat the bundled RJ45 CAN cable at both the inverter BMS port and the pack COMM port.
solutions.ur: Bundled RJ45 CAN cable ko inverter BMS port aur pack COMM port dono par dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Set battery type to Lib in LCD setting No. 08, as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq LCD setting No. 08 mein battery type Lib par set karein.

solutions.en: Power the pack first, then the inverter, and confirm the 'C' communication icon appears on the LCD.
solutions.ur: Pehle pack ko power karein, phir inverter ko, aur LCD par 'C' communication icon aane ka confirm karein.

source.title: IVEM Series (3KVA~5KVA) Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-010045-10)

aliases: The AC input and output wires are inversely connected

meaning.en: The AC input and output wires are inversely connected.
meaning.ur: AC input aur output wires aik doosre ki jagah lagi hain.

causes.en: Grid and load cables swapped at the AC terminal block
causes.ur: AC terminal block par grid aur load ke cables aik doosre ki jagah lage hue hain

causes.en: Error during a parallel installation where the wiring was landed by guesswork
causes.ur: Parallel installation mein ghalti se wiring lagane ki wajah se error

solutions.en: Check that the AC input and output wires are connected correctly at the terminal block.
solutions.ur: Terminal block par check karein ke AC input aur output wires theek lagi hain.

solutions.en: If this happened during parallel installation, re-check the wiring and finish the parallel installation before restarting.
solutions.ur: Agar yeh parallel installation ke dauran hua to wiring dobara check karke parallel installation mukammal karein, phir restart karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the input and output power lines correspond on all phases before closing the breakers.
solutions.ur: Breakers band karne se pehle confirm karein ke input aur output power lines sab phases par aik doosre se match karte hain.

source.title: IVEM Series (3KVA~5KVA) Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-010045-10)

aliases: Single unit is installed to parallel system

title.en: Fault 28 Single unit on parallel system
title.ur: Fault 28 Parallel system par aik unit

meaning.en: A single unit is installed into a parallel system.
meaning.ur: Parallel system mein aik hi unit lagi hui hai.

causes.en: Only one unit of a multi-unit bank switched on
causes.ur: Multi-unit bank mein sirf aik unit on hai

causes.en: Parallel setup programmed but sharing cables not connected to every unit
causes.ur: Parallel setup to ho gaya lekin sharing cables har unit par nahi lagi

solutions.en: Check whether a single unit has been installed into a parallel system.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke parallel system mein koi aik unit to nahi lagi.

solutions.en: If this error happens during parallel installation, check the wiring and finish the parallel installation first, then restart.
solutions.ur: Agar yeh parallel installation ke dauran ho to wiring check karein aur pehle parallel installation mukammal karein, phir restart karein.

solutions.en: Confirm every unit in the bank has the sharing and CAN cables connected before switching any of them on.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke bank ka har unit sharing aur CAN cables ke saath laga hua hai, tab koi unit on karein.

source.title: IVEM Series (3KVA~5KVA) Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-010045-10)

meaning.en: The DC/DC converter soft start did not complete.
meaning.ur: DC/DC converter ka soft start mukammal nahi hua.

causes.en: Battery voltage too low to start the DC/DC converter
causes.ur: Battery voltage DC/DC converter shuru karne ke liye bohat kam hai

causes.en: DC/DC pre-charge circuit or its capacitor fault
causes.ur: DC/DC pre-charge circuit ya uska capacitor kharab hai

causes.en: Internal component failure in the DC/DC stage
causes.ur: DC/DC stage mein internal component ki failure

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage and confirm it is above the DC/DC start threshold.
solutions.ur: Battery voltage measure karke confirm karein ke woh DC/DC start threshold se upar hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery and inspect the DC/DC pre-charge circuit and connectors.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke DC/DC pre-charge circuit aur connectors dekhein.

solutions.en: Restart once as the manual directs; if the code returns, the DC/DC stage needs service-centre repair.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq aik baar restart karein; code wapas aaye to DC/DC stage ko service centre par marammat karwayein.

source.title: IVEM Series (3KVA~5KVA) Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-010045-10)

meaning.en: CAN data between parallel units has been lost.
meaning.ur: Parallel units ke darmiyan CAN data kho gaya hai.

causes.en: Parallel CAN communication cable loose or unplugged
causes.ur: Parallel CAN communication cable dhili hai ya nikal gayi

causes.en: CAN cable damaged during installation
causes.ur: Installation ke dauran CAN cable kharab ho gayi

solutions.en: Check that the communication cables are connected well and restart the inverter.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke communication cables theek lagi hain aur inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: Test the CAN cable end to end with a meter and replace it if the continuity is broken.
solutions.ur: CAN cable ki end-to-end continuity meter se test karein aur continuity tooti ho to replace karein.

solutions.en: If the problem remains, contact the installer as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: Masla bacha rahe to manual ke mutabiq installer se rabta karein.

source.title: IVEM Series (3KVA~5KVA) Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-010045-10)

meaning.en: Data from the parallel host unit has been lost.
meaning.ur: Parallel host unit ka data kho gaya hai.

causes.en: Host unit switched off while the bank was running
causes.ur: Bank chalte waqt host unit band ho gaya

causes.en: CAN link between host and this unit intermittent
causes.ur: Host aur is unit ke darmiyan CAN link intermittent hai

solutions.en: Check that the communication cables are connected well and restart the inverter.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke communication cables theek lagi hain aur inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: Read every unit's own fault code in the bank and fix the host's error first.
solutions.ur: Bank mein har unit ka apna fault code padhein aur pehle host ka error theek karein.

solutions.en: If the problem remains, contact the installer as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: Masla bacha rahe to manual ke mutabiq installer se rabta karein.

source.title: IVEM Series (3KVA~5KVA) Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-010045-10)

meaning.en: Synchronisation data between parallel units has been lost.
meaning.ur: Parallel units ke darmiyan synchronisation data kho gaya hai.

causes.en: Phase assignment (program 28) differs between units in the bank
causes.ur: Bank ke units ka phase assignment (program 28) alag alag hai

causes.en: N conductors not all commoned across the bank
causes.ur: Bank ke darmiyan saare N conductors common nahi kiye gaye

causes.en: Communication cable loose
causes.ur: Communication cable dhili hai

solutions.en: Check that the communication cables are connected well and restart the inverter.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke communication cables theek lagi hain aur inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: Confirm all N wires of AC output are connected together, as the manual's notes require.
solutions.ur: Manual ke notes ke mutabiq confirm karein ke AC output ke saare N wires aik saath jure hue hain.

solutions.en: Verify every unit has the same program 28 setting; restart the whole bank once.
solutions.ur: Har unit ka program 28 setting aik jaisa hai ya nahi check karein; poore bank ko aik baar restart karein.

source.title: IVEM Series (3KVA~5KVA) Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-010045-10)

aliases: Current feedback into the inverter is detected

meaning.en: Current is feeding back into the inverter, which is unsafe for a parallel bank.
meaning.ur: Inverter mein current wapas aa raha hai, jo parallel bank ke liye khatarnaak hai.

causes.en: L/N cables connected in reverse in one of the inverters
causes.ur: Aik inverter mein L/N cables ulat lagi hain

causes.en: Sharing cables not connected in all units of a single-phase parallel system
causes.ur: Single-phase parallel system mein sabhi units par sharing cables nahi lagi

causes.en: Sharing cables connected between units on different phases in a three-phase system
causes.ur: Three-phase system mein alag phases wale units ke darmiyan sharing cables lagaye gaye

solutions.en: Restart the inverter, then check that L/N cables are not connected in reverse in ALL inverters.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein, phir check karein ke SAARI inverters mein L/N cables ulat nahi lagi hain.

solutions.en: For a single-phase parallel system, make sure the sharing cables are connected in all inverters.
solutions.ur: Single-phase parallel system mein confirm karein ke sharing cables sabhi inverters par lagi hain.

solutions.en: For a three-phase system, sharing cables must be connected only between units on the SAME phase and disconnected between different phases.
solutions.ur: Three-phase system mein sharing cables sirf usi phase wale units ke darmiyan honi chahiyein, alag phases mein disconnected.

source.title: IVEM Series (3KVA~5KVA) Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-010045-10)

aliases: The firmware version of each inverter is not the same

meaning.en: The parallel units do not run the same firmware version.
meaning.ur: Parallel units aik hi firmware version par nahi chal rahe.

causes.en: One unit was updated and the others were not
causes.ur: Aik unit update hua lekin baqi nahi

causes.en: Different production batches with different firmware
causes.ur: Alag production batch mein alag firmware

solutions.en: Update all inverter firmware to the same version, as the manual lists.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq sabhi inverter ka firmware aik hi version par update karein.

solutions.en: Check each unit's version through the LCD setting and make sure the CPU versions are the same.
solutions.ur: LCD setting se har unit ka version dekhein aur confirm karein ke CPU versions aik jaise hain.

solutions.en: If they are not the same, ask the installer to supply the firmware, then contact after-sales if it still persists.
solutions.ur: Versions aik jaise na hon to installer se firmware mangwayein, phir bhi masla rahe to after-sales se rabta karein.

source.title: IVEM Series (3KVA~5KVA) Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-010045-10)

aliases: The output current of each inverter is different

title.en: Fault 45 Unequal output current per inverter
title.ur: Fault 45 Har inverter ka output current alag

meaning.en: The output current of each inverter in the bank is different.
meaning.ur: Bank mein har inverter ka output current alag alag hai.

causes.en: Sharing cables loose so current is not shared evenly
causes.ur: Sharing cables dhile hain jis se current barabar se share nahi ho raha

causes.en: One unit's current sensor reading drift
causes.ur: Aik unit ke current sensor ki reading drift ho gayi

causes.en: One unit's output voltage set differently in the setup
causes.ur: Aik unit ka output voltage setup mein alag set hai

solutions.en: Check that the sharing cables are connected well and restart the inverter.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke sharing cables theek lagi hain aur inverter restart karein.

solutions.en: Compare each unit's output current on the LCD with a clamp meter on its output conductor.
solutions.ur: LCD par har unit ka output current us ke output conductor par clamp meter se compare karein.

solutions.en: If the problem remains, contact the installer as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: Masla bacha rahe to manual ke mutabiq installer se rabta karein.

source.title: IVEM Series (3KVA~5KVA) Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-010045-10)

aliases: AC output mode setting is different

title.en: Fault 46 AC output mode setting differs
title.ur: Fault 46 AC output mode setting alag

meaning.en: The units in the bank have different AC output mode settings.
meaning.ur: Bank ke units ke AC output mode settings alag hain.

causes.en: One unit left in 3P1/3P2/3P3 while the rest are set to PAL
causes.ur: Aik unit 3P1/3P2/3P3 par chhor diya gaya jabke baqi PAL par hain

causes.en: Setup changed on one unit after the bank was commissioned
causes.ur: Bank commission hone ke baad aik unit ka setup badal diya gaya

solutions.en: Switch off the inverter and check LCD setting program 28, as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq inverter band karke LCD setting program 28 check karein.

solutions.en: For a single-phase parallel system, make sure NO unit has 3P1, 3P2 or 3P3 set on program 28.
solutions.ur: Single-phase parallel system mein confirm karein ke kisi unit par program 28 par 3P1, 3P2 ya 3P3 set NAHI hai.

solutions.en: For a three-phase system, make sure no 'PAL' is set on program 28.
solutions.ur: Three-phase system mein confirm karein ke program 28 par kisi unit par 'PAL' set NAHI hai.

source.title: IVEM Series (3KVA~5KVA) Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-010045-10)
